verses.text: Family, I couldn’t talk to you like people led by the Spirit yet. I had to talk to you like people still run by the flesh—like little babies in Christ.
I gave you milk, not solid food, because you weren’t ready for it. And honestly, you still aren’t ready,
because jealousy, arguments, and cliques are still running the show. That’s fleshly behavior—just moving like the world.
When one person says, “I’m team Paul,” and another says, “I’m team Apollos,” aren’t you acting like the world?
So who are Paul and Apollos? Just servants who helped you believe, each doing the work the Lord assigned.
I planted the seed, Apollos watered it, but God made it grow. 🌱
So the one planting isn’t the main thing, and the one watering isn’t either. God is the one who makes it grow.
The planter and the waterer are on the same team, but each will get their own reward for their own work.
We’re God’s coworkers. You’re God’s field and God’s building.
By the grace God gave me, I laid a foundation like a skilled builder. Someone else is building on it, so each person needs to watch how they build.
Nobody can lay another foundation besides the one already laid: Jesus Christ.
Some people build on that foundation with gold, silver, and precious stones; others use wood, hay, or straw.
Each person’s work will come out in the open. The Day will reveal it, because fire will expose and test what kind of work everyone has done.
If what someone built survives, they’ll receive a reward.
If someone’s work burns up, they’ll lose out. They’ll still be saved, but it’ll be like escaping through fire.
Don’t you know you all are God’s temple, and God’s Spirit lives among you? 🕊️
If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy them. God’s temple is holy—and that temple is you.
Don’t fool yourself. If you think you’re wise by this world’s standards, become a fool in the world’s eyes so you can become truly wise.
This world’s wisdom is foolishness to God. Scripture says, “He catches the wise in their own cleverness.”
And again: “The Lord knows the thoughts of the wise—they don’t amount to much.”
So stop bragging about people. Everything belongs to you:
Paul, Apollos, Cephas, the world, life, death, what’s happening now, and what’s coming—all of it belongs to you.
And you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
